summary: Phase 9 Nifty OAuth plumbing tested end-to-end. Backend (18/18 pytest pass) and Frontend (all flows pass).
critical_code_review_comments: integrations_admin_routes.py:exchange — uses request.scope.get('user') which is None in FastAPI; the recorded oauth_state always has user=null. Cosmetic — replace with Depends(get_current_user) injection to capture the admin email. Non-blocking.

AuthCallback.jsx success copy says 'Token saved + verified' on manual-token save, but verification (ping) actually fails for fake tokens. The card transitions to 'Token saved · ping failed' badge correctly, so the toast wording is just slightly optimistic. Already flagged in problem statement.
NiftyClient._current_access_token — when refresh fails and stored is expired, falls back to stored access_token. Safe but logs nothing. Suggest log.warning to aid future debugging.
test_credentials: Admin founder@thesalvador.group / admin123; Client testclient@bybloomlabs.com / clientpass123 (used for role separation).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. The test suite saves a manual fake token then disconnects in cleanup fixture. oauth_states entries created by authorize-url calls — they are short-lived CSRF tokens, intentionally left in the collection (no TTL configured, but harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 9 admin/integrations endpoints (status/authorize-url/exchange/manual-token/disconnect/projects/members) all working. Real OAuth handshake cannot be exercised (redirect URI locked to prod). Manual-token saves with source='manual', ping fails as expected with fake token, status correctly returns connected:true + ping_ok:false. Disconnect removes the doc. Auto-refresh path not exercised (would need real Nifty refresh_token).
